summary: The Backrooms is a survival RPG across authored maze levels, player-specific rooms and shared destinations such as the Bonus Room mall. `templates/player.js` composes player behaviors while scenes and place simulations supply environments and local systems; shared loot, build, breakable and loose-item systems connect exploration and physics interactions.
places: places/bonus (3D) - shared vaporwave mall with shops, arcade, fountain, court storefronts and west-balcony lounge; authored shops plus shopper/staff simulation.
places/main (3D) - authored Level 0/Lobby maze; sim generates furniture/loot, safe-room almond water, shifting walls, creature ecology and versioned route-guidance moments.
places/intake (3D) + places/tutorial0 (solo ephemeral 3D) - bedroom character-creation/waking space and authored Level 0 tutorial route with staged encounter and HALOGEN.

places/level1, places/level2, places/level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone, Pipe Dreams and Locked; authored levels with local generation, loot and agents; Level 1 has modeled loose drums/pallets and Level 2's modeled kit overlays its collider shell.
places/level3, places/gamma, places/level4, places/level5 (3D) - Electrical Station, Base Gamma, Abandoned Office and Terror Hotel; residents, hazards, office/home systems and Boiler Room rats.
places/level6, places/level7, places/level10, places/level11 (3D) - later authored/generated levels including city, farm and venues; Level 10's fun poster routes to Level 26.
places/level26 (3D) - SS Fun =), Adventure liner lost in green fog; bespoke hull/cabin meshes, bridge, funnel, deck, pool, wrecked bar/restaurant, Partygoers and balloons.
places/debug, places/spamton and other configured places - auxiliary debug/fight spaces and continuing Backrooms routes; all are 3D except tutorial0's solo ephemeral instance.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, player/camera setup and ordered behavior composition; L maps to kick and Z to grab.

places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - place settings, authored placements and local generated/ticked behavior; places/main/sim.js owns Level 0 generation and timers; sim.js owns world cadence and out-of-bounds recovery.
scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js - title/pause, character creation, arrival, tutorial routing and first-arrival Level 26 cutscene driver.
places/intake/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/intake-geo.js + scripts/lib/intro-cut.js - bedroom shell and waking sequence; tutorial scene plus tut0 geometry/sim scripts own its route and beats.
scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js - camera and third-person toggle; scripts/ui.js and specialized UI scripts present HUD, panels and cutscenes.
art/l26-ship/{build,hull,super,lib,tex}.py - Blender source pipeline exporting Level 26 liner hull/superstructure GLBs and ship textures.
art/level2/{build,compact,encode,pack}.py - offline Level 2 kit geometry/data compaction and packing pipeline for the runtime kit decoder.
art/human-base/build.py - Blender pipeline builds female and reshaped male human base meshes, rigs them and exports GLBs; not evidence of runtime use by itself.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js - shared/solo room IDs, Bonus Room and home destinations/crossings; used by routing and hub handlers and defines last-level selection/names.
scripts/lib/loot.js + items.js + weapons.js/weapons.yml - common loot spawning, container rolls, remains, place pools and weapon definitions/rarity reused by search and combat.
scripts/lib/build-piece.js + breakables.yml + furniture.yml - canonical build specs/models shared by B-mode and home reconstruction; CRT TV builds attach scripts/built-tv.js.
scripts/lib/screen.js - derived read-only panel classifier and wrist gates shared by player, stats, craft, rest and menu input.
scripts/lib/maze.js and scripts/lib/level*.js + level data - grids, zones, layouts and paths reused by place sims, geometry and navigation.
scripts/lib/clothes.js + clothes.yml + critter.yml + hair.yml + scripts/lib/critter-model.js - wardrobe/look rules and player/NPC critter models; shared renderer also supports creator appearance.

scripts/lib/l2kit.js - Level 2 model-instance drawing/decoding from scripts/lib/l2kit-data, used by scripts/l2kit/*-geo.js; scripts/lib/knock.js - kicked/thrown-body recovery shared by enemy managers.
scripts/lib/loose.js + scripts/lib/data/loose.yml - name-matched material, mass, hit points, impact thresholds and break acts; shared by grab, kick and breakables.
notableExports: scripts/lib/loot.js - POOL, poolOf, rollWeapon, gateItems, rollItem, spawnCrate, rollLoot and level-specific loot helpers; scripts/lib/weapons.js - rarityIdx, rarityCap and weapon registry.
scripts/grab.js - setDown, onInput, update, looseSpent; carrying, throwing and scheduled extinguisher-jet expiry. scripts/kick.js - onInput, kickEnd, update.
scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, gain, takeToken, useSnack, onInput, hitTarget and fishing handlers.
scripts/lib/screen.js - WRIST, screen, canOpen, openWrist; scripts/routing.js - pickRoom.
sim.js - cadence, tick, onOutOfBounds; places/main/sim.js and places/bonus/sim.js - cadence, tick.
scripts/partygoers.js - update; manager for tagged Partygoers and Carnivorous Balloons on Level 26. scripts/lib/knock.js - knocked, foeStats.

scripts/lib/loose.js - looseOf, arm, impact, breakIt, kickLoose, track, stepFlights; scripts/lib/breakables.js - classOf, damageEntity, strike, wall and rubble helpers; scripts/lib/l2kit.js - placements, unpack, kit, PARTS, spawnKit.
scripts/built-tv.js - ears; E cycles the build-menu CRT through shared TV channels and off.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo, needs, money, appearance, combat/rewards and level access; saved place/position and one-shot wakeAtSave position restoration.
scripts/kick.js + scripts/grab.js - per-player kick rolls/cooldowns, carried prop/body IDs, held-body grip and throw/carry session fields; target body state.heldBy/down controls hold and release.
scripts/lib/loose.js - arms matched props with state.loose/mat/hp/maxHp and owns their broke/act effects; per-player session.loose tracks kicked/thrown item flights until impact.
scripts/lib/knock.js - shared physics/timing recovery for down/kb and thrown/overboard records; enemy managers retain AI state and pause it while held or recovering.
scripts/lurkers.js - player.state.lurkHold while caught and lurker entity grab/frenzy/prey state; release clears the player's hold.
scripts/build.js - active B-mode selection/ghost/session and placed build pieces; homeKeep.built persists home builds reconstructed by home sim.
scripts/hub.js - mall offer/shop/food and room-hop flags plus player trainHid/stungUntil; session.ride/rideTrain holds the transient transit scene and spawned train.

scripts/partygoers.js - Level 26 AI state (pack hunting, berserk hatch cycles, lunge/dodge/barrage/combo timing, stun/gait and balloon bob/gas); partygoers and scripts/hub.js write player.state.stungUntil, which scripts/player.js enforces.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered behaviors: locomotion/player, swim, interact/grab/kick/rest/mahjong/talk/build/noclip/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/spamton-fight/horde/critter/main-menu/hub/view3.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes player.state.aimPt → player.js crosshair-aligned shots.
scripts/routing.js accepts permitted requested rooms; otherwise scripts/lib/hub.js soloRoom selects player's solo Backrooms room and bonus overflow IDs.
Fresh visit → scripts/main-menu.js; START enters intake for creation or bonus for completed characters; wardrobe close runs intro-cut then tutorial0 unless t0Done.
scripts/lib/hub.js toHub/toSolo → room/place crossings; roomHop distinguishes intentional crossings from launch/resume.
Death recovery → scripts/hub.js hubOffer → hub-ui.js; mall counters write hubShop → hub handler/UI; purchases debit cents and grant configured stock.

Teleport Station UI in scripts/hub-ui.js renders lastLevel(s) from scripts/lib/hub.js; travel requests reach scripts/hub.js, which boards the player via the bc-train scene, hides the placed car, animates a session train and then crosses to the selected room.

Found loot search → scripts/interact.js calls loot.gateItems for non-storage/non-NPC contents; found weapon rarity cap is level 1-2 common, 3-5 uncommon, 6-9 rare, 10+ elite; pickup weapons/food/aid enters player.js inventory.

L input → scripts/kick.js tries foe kick then loose.js kickLoose; Z input → scripts/grab.js picks/carries/throws eligible bodies and calls loose.js arm/track/impact; flight tracking lives in player session and detects hard stops.

scripts/lib/breakables.js strike/damageEntity → loose.js breakIt for matched loose props, otherwise generic rubble; loose.yml supplies material/hp/act rules, with breakAt as impact-energy threshold; explosions emit damage/noise/shockwave.
places/level1/sim.js l1Tripo migration spawns modeled oil drums and box pallets as l1prop entities; loose.yml matches their metal/wood material and loose.js, grab/kick and combat handle interactions.
Level 2 places/level2/sim.js → scripts/lib/l2kit.js spawnKit and scripts/l2kit/*-geo.js visuals; seeded rooms upgrade via kitV while scripts/level2-geo.js retains the collider shell.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/lib/data/bonus.yml + places/bonus/sim.js + scripts/mall-shopper.js - authored mall shops/landmarks with data-driven stock and simulated staff, waypoint shoppers and balcony loungers.

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + scripts/lib/build-piece.js + scripts/build.js + places/home11/sim.js - per-piece models/dimensions with common placement, persistence and rebuild path; CRT TV builds add matching screen, sound and glow child.
places/main/cells/* and places/level5/cells/* - authored fixtures with local sound/light and zone variants; Level 5 includes portal/quest props and Boiler Room Death Rat packs.
places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + Level 4 geometry/detail/prop/look and l4-office.js/l4-office-geo.js/l4-home.js - office layout and fixtures with resident schedules/home claims.
scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - per-NPC role/dialogue/look/routine on shared meg-agent behavior.

scripts/lib/clothes.js + scripts/lib/critter-model.js + critter.yml/hair.yml + art/critter-hair/build.py - player and NPC critter rendering; generated styles have normal and hat-compressed hair meshes, with head/ear-fit envelope shaping.

art/level2/{build,compact,encode,pack}.py + scripts/lib/data/l2kit-data/* + scripts/lib/l2kit.js - module meshes are compact-packed and decoded into runtime instances; optional UV data, otherwise triplanar projection.

scripts/lib/data/loose.yml + scripts/lib/loose.js + grab.js/kick.js/breakables.js - matched physics props share impact tracking and material-specific acts: shatter/spill, splinter, spark, spray, explosion, pop, splat, dent or bounce.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - exports procedural balloon geometry/skeleton/collider but has no references; Level 26 scene placements and barrage use uploaded models instead.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - header marks it as a temporary hair lane test rig; no tree/package references found.
migrationNotes: Bonus Room uses shared room/place bonus; soloRoom(userId) names each player's Backrooms room and overflow mall rooms use bonus-N IDs. Keep routing and hub identity aligned.

Teleport Station 'last' travel derives from savePlace (excluding bonus, intake and debug; tutorial0 maps to main); keepPos preserves savePos and wakeAtSave restores it only when the arriving place matches. Travel also depends on the bc-train scene and its session train.
Found-item rarity gates apply only to found weapon tokens; ownership/use of existing weapons and non-weapon loot is not level-gated. Search gating excludes storage and NPC containers.
Level 0 place.state.momentsV is 4: its migration deletes old tagged moment entities before relaying them; preserve deterministic route/arrow direction logic when changing moment layout.
At sanity <= 0 health is not drained; scripts/lib/stats.js lowers derived attributes except Luck by 2 (minimum 1), and derived values feed combat, carry and movement.

scripts/lib/knock.js consumes transient down/kb records and thrown-body flight/overboard state; enemy managers must call knocked() before AI and exclude heldBy bodies. loose.yml breakAt uses joules: 0.5 × kg × speed². art/human-base/build.py expects /workspace/human/female_raw.glb and exports 1.65 m female / 1.78 m male Mixamo-named rigs; these new assets do not imply the live critter renderer uses them.
